description: OpenTofu state-encryption block, which Terraform itself rejects, alongside an unencrypted SQS queue
note: The case that proves OpenTofu-only syntax does not cost us the file. Trivy's HCL parser tolerates the unknown `encryption` block rather than failing, so the queue finding still fires; if a Trivy bump changed that, this case goes red and the scan_errors count moves. Measured 2026-09-16: fired, with no scan_errors, so the unknown block cost nothing. checkov raised nothing here either, as above.
